behavior.explanation: The available source establishes the download-to-file path but not the decisive authorization logic. The Download entry is at src/documents/views.py:1835, and the shown file-response helper first calls _resolve_request_and_root_doc(pk, request, include_deleted=True). If that result is an HttpResponseForbidden, it returns the forbidden response immediately. Otherwise it calls _get_effective_file_doc(resolved.request_doc, resolved.root_doc, request), then serves that resulting file document. File representation is selected separately: use_archive is true when original_requested(request) is false and the effective file document has an archive version; otherwise the original representation is used. Thus the requested document and any root/request-document relationship are resolved before the effective file document is chosen, while original/archive selection affects which representation is served after that resolution. The shown source does not establish whether a selected version changes the authorization subject, whether authorization is checked on the requested document, root document, effective version, or another object, or how ownership and direct/group object grants are evaluated. No runtime execution was performed.
